title: Pyramidal Circuit
description: 3-round circuit followed by a squat pyramid: progressive full body power build-up

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Brisk in-place march
exercises.instructions: March quickly in place with arm swing

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm to the sky

exercises.name: Walking lunges
exercises.instructions: Step forward continuously with long strides

exercises.name: Wide push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands wider than shoulders, focus on the chest

exercises.name: Forearm plank
exercises.instructions: On forearms, body perfectly aligned, brace the abs

exercises.name: Step-ups
exercises.instructions: Step up and down a step alternating legs

exercises.name: Sumo squats
exercises.instructions: Feet very wide, toes pointed out

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, rotate from side to side

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
